notes.title: Steam Major Update Announcement
notes.notes: [p]Dear players,[/p][p]Thank you for your continued support! We highly value your feedback, and this major update brings a series of fixes and improvements to enhance your overall experience:[/p][p]1. Fixed the black screen issue after pressing Start Game.[/p][p]2. Fixed the button failure when no dialogue options were available.[/p][p]3. Fixed the black screen at the beginning of the hidden side story.[/p][p]4. Fixed the infinite loop at the end of Chapter 10.[/p][p]5. Fixed the issue where the next line would not auto-progress after selecting an option.[/p][p]6. All English localization text has been manually proofread, making the reading experience smoother and more natural.[/p][p]7. The English version now features newly recorded voice acting by professional actors, making performances more emotional and authentic.[/p][p]We will continue to listen to our community and keep improving the game experience. Thank you for your patience and passionate support, enjoy the game![/p][p][/p][p]Tarnaki Games[/p]
